mgmt_bio.text: Wei Che-Chia, known as C.C. Wei, is a Taiwanese business executive and electrical engineer who serves as chairman and chief executive officer of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited; he holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from National Chiao Tung University and a Ph.D. from Yale University. Before joining TSMC in 1998 he was senior vice president of technology at Chartered Semiconductor Manufacturing in Singapore, senior manager for logic and SRAM technology development at STMicroelectronics, and earlier a member of technical staff in Texas Instruments' R&D organization.
